# GAMM partial effects for the aligned Big Five scores

This script gives the following figure: Figure 6, Partial Effects of the Aligned Big Five Scores in the Generalised Additive Mixed Model (Results section).

```{r}
# The packages for drawing and arranging the panels are loaded.
library(gratia)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# The saved training-set model is loaded.
# The script stops if the model does not contain the 49,207 training observations.
fit <- readRDS("gamm_trait_model.rds")
stopifnot(nobs(fit) == 49207)

# Each smooth in the model is linked to its panel title. The order of this list sets the order of the panels.
trait_names <- c(
  "s(CON_z)" = "Conscientiousness",
  "s(AGR_z)" = "Agreeableness",
  "s(OPE_z)" = "Openness",
  "s(EXT_z)" = "Extraversion",
  "s(NEU_z)" = "Neuroticism"
)
```

## Drawing the smooths

```{r}
# gratia draws the original smooth plot: one panel per trait, with the smooth, its confidence band, and a rug of the observed scores.
panels <- draw(
  fit,
  select = names(trait_names),
  caption = FALSE,
  ci_col = "grey50",
  ci_alpha = 0.35,
  wrap = FALSE
)
# The panels are ordered as conscientiousness, agreeableness, openness, extraversion, and neuroticism.
panels <- panels[names(trait_names)]
```

## Adjusting the panels

```{r}
# The original plot is then adjusted.
# Every panel has a white background, dashed horizontal grid lines, and a centred title.
panel_theme <- theme_bw(base_size = 11, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey80", linetype = "dashed"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 8, 2, 4)
  )

# Every panel receives a line at zero, an x-axis from -4.5 to 4.5, a y-axis from -0.6 to 0.6, and the theme above.
panel_format <- list(
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.6),
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-4, 4, by = 2)),
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(-0.6, 0.6, by = 0.2),
    labels = c("-0.6", "-0.4", "-0.2", "0", "0.2", "0.4", "0.6")
  ),
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-4.5, 4.5), ylim = c(-0.6, 0.6)),
  panel_theme
)

# The shared format is applied, and each panel receives its own title.
# The panel has no x-axis title, because one title is placed below the figure.
for (i in seq_along(panels)) {
  panels[[i]] <- panels[[i]] +
    panel_format +
    labs(title = trait_names[[i]], x = NULL)
}
```

## Arranging the panels on the page

```{r}
# The upper row contains conscientiousness, agreeableness, and openness.
# The y-axis is shown once, on the left of this row.
top_row <- panels[[1]] + panels[[2]] + panels[[3]] +
  plot_layout(nrow = 1, axes = "collect_y", axis_titles = "collect_y")

# This theme removes the y-axis. It is applied to neuroticism, so the lower row shows the y-axis only beside extraversion.
hide_y <- theme(
  axis.text.y = element_blank(),
  axis.title.y = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
)
# Extraversion and neuroticism are centred between two empty spaces.
# The widths give these panels the same width as the panels above.
bottom_row <- plot_spacer() + panels[[4]] + (panels[[5]] + hide_y) + plot_spacer() +
  plot_layout(
    nrow = 1,
    widths = c(0.343, 1, 1, 0.343),
    axes = "collect_y",
    axis_titles = "collect_y"
  )

# One x-axis title is placed below the figure.
x_title <- wrap_elements(
  full = grid::textGrob(
    "Standardised aligned Big Five score",
    gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 11, fontfamily = "Arial", col = "black")
  )
)

# The upper row, the lower row, and the x-axis title are combined.
# The title occupies a narrow strip at the bottom of the page.
figure_gamm_smooths <- top_row / bottom_row / x_title +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 0.045))
figure_gamm_smooths
```

## Saving the figure

```{r}
# The figure is saved as the PDF for Figure 6, Partial Effects of the Aligned Big Five Scores in the Generalised Additive Mixed Model (Results section).
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave(
  "figures/figure_gamm_smooths.pdf",
  plot = figure_gamm_smooths,
  width = 19.05,
  height = 13.72,
  units = "cm",
  device = cairo_pdf
)
```
